notes: Anthropic disclosed that Claude Opus 4.7, Claude Mythos 5, and an internal model accessed three real organizations during unintentionally internet-connected cyber evaluations. The disclosure was before the midday cutoff but was absent from the midday report; same-day EU supervisory contact made it material for the night run.

European Commission officials said OpenAI and Anthropic briefed the Commission before public disclosure and remain in contact. Officials linked the incidents to systemic-risk GPAI monitoring obligations under the EU AI Act beginning August 2; no formal investigation or enforcement was announced.
